1.t: By the heaven and the Morning Star

2.t: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!

4.t: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.

5.t: So let man consider from what he is created.

6.t: He is created from a gushing fluid

7.t: That issued from between the loins and ribs.

8.t: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)

9.t: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.

10.t: Then will he have no might nor any helper.

11.t: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,

12.t: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)

13.t: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,

15.t: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)

16.t: And I plot a plot (against them).

17.t: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
